scope: Local re-examination only; no new cloud request or router operation. Device OTA total remains 104 POSTs and one prior G6 CDN GET. No new native target execution in this review.
question: Why did even the genuinely older ONT image return no offer?

older_image_confirmed.interpretation: Actual build dates establish older/newer; trailing K67 versus K50 numbers are not a chronological sort.

existing_control.scope: 62 two-second-spaced discovery scenarios. Actual saved owner serial/MAC/model/key held fixed; BOQA country grid plus8 operator-header codes present in both shipped profile inventories. Codes/countries are hypothetical query inputs, not actual device provisioning or verified country/operator pairings. Native isopctl=N. No router, enrollment/status PUT/install operation.
existing_control.conclusion: The same earlier G6 identity/key/model/version/country context gives an offer under BOQA and no offer under ALCL. This demonstrates operator-context-sensitive availability, without recovering the complete vendor server policy.

response_interpretation: The ONT response has code 200 and Request processed successfully. It echoes the submitted model/version but supplies null nextVersion, URL and checksum. This does not independently establish enrollment, a matching firmware assignment, correctness of every profile input or the newest global release.
known_profile_gap: The packaged GENERIC 41-byte API default was used. The plaintext of the actual stored 76-byte wrapped string remains unverified. Matching the profile reproducer to our saved constructed request is a self-consistency check, not proof of byte-for-byte native ONT request equality.
saved_enable_flag: Saved cloud OTA Enable=false. Enable is not an outgoing header/body field in this request. It cannot be cited as the direct cause of the external no-offer; native cloud OTA use has not been established for this captured configuration.

new_offline_negative_checks.material: Eleven static returned strings plus decoded hex forms for key0/key1/key2; each tested with PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256, 10 or 100 rounds, and AES-256-CBC/PKCS7 against the FF + salt8 stored API value.
new_offline_negative_checks.limits: Bounded hypothesis tests, not comprehensive credential decryption, not proof packageddefault is wrong or correct. No candidate passwords/keys printed or sent.

request_recheck: Reviewed swmgnt header builder/payload and libnal getters. Model, serial, MAC, operator and country sources are consistent with the constructed request. ROOT_CA usage is trust configuration, not a newly demonstrated missing client-authentication certificate. Effective credential equality remains unresolved.
next_discriminating_check: Compare actual stock cfg/libnal effective APIcredential and exact native request profile with the private constructed one. Read-only getter or captured request needed; do not start updater/activate a bank merely to check availability.
current_conclusion: No offer for the tested VDQA profile, with an unverified effective API credential. Actual native ONT cloud availability remains inconclusive. Another operator delivery path or lack of a matching server-side assignment is plausible, not proven.

additional_static_crypto_review.cfgUtl_getCryptValue: libdbgen 0x100a8: mode 1 uses CS_getCryptOutLen/CS_crypt with type 2. Mode 2 resolves the caller-supplied key name through SE_getKeyByName, then SE_encStr2StrEx. This does not establish which mode/key the current saved API field uses.
additional_static_crypto_review.string_crypto: libsec_engine SE_encStr2StrEx 0x25a24 calls helper 0x25200. Cipher name is AES256 at 0x33b10, resolved through EVP_get_cipherbyname. Helper checks marker FF and reads an 8-byte salt; PKCS5_PBKDF2_HMAC is the 0x46db8 GOT relocation and EVP_sha256 is 0x46dd8. Wrapper retries decrypt with its 10/100-round alternative. This supports the bounded CBC hypothesis tests but does not identify the API field key.
